product_launches.description: United Solar Polysilicon is preparing for the full commercial launch of its large polysilicon production plant in Sohar Freezone, Oman, which will supply high-purity polysilicon for solar and semiconductor markets.

overview_description.description: United Solar Polysilicon produces high-purity polysilicon used as a key raw material for manufacturing photovoltaic cells in the solar energy supply chain. The company operates a large-scale polysilicon manufacturing facility designed to supply materials that support multi-gigawatt solar panel production and to serve customers in the solar manufacturing sector. It focuses on continuous production process improvements, automated operations, and scalability to address evolving market needs. United Solar Polysilicon also engages in strategic partnerships to extend the use of its products in broader solar projects and supports sustainability through production practices that aim to reduce environmental impact.
